title: Theme declaration
description: The interface's look, declared once. Every theme here is compiled into the binary and cooked as a loadable asset from the same entry. A theme is a whole style -- colours and metrics together -- so a theme built for a smaller or poorer display can ask for larger text and wider borders, not only different colours. See docs/subsystems/UI.md and docs/formats/THEME_FORMAT.md.

metrics.description: Whole-pixel measurements and repeat timing. Every field is required in the declaration's top-level metrics, which are the defaults a theme falls back to for any field it does not name in its own metrics override.

themes.description: Compiled into the binary as UiBuiltinTheme, and cooked as a loadable THEME_<NAME> asset from the same entry.

name.description: Upper snake case. Becomes UiBuiltinTheme::<name> and the cooked asset key THEME_<name>.

colors.description: One entry per UiColor role. The generator checks this against the engine's own enum, so a role added there and forgotten here fails the build rather than drawing black.

metrics.description: Overrides the declaration's top-level metrics field by field; anything not named here is inherited from those defaults.

fonts.description: Which cooked font asset serves each text role. A role left unset falls through to the built-in font.
